text: Illustrate the story here: Thump! Thump! Thud! Thad and Cath go on a jog at camp. They have six paths to pick from. They pick the fifth path. Thump! Thump! Thud! "What was that?" asks Cath. Thad looks and sees a big rock on the path. "This rock fell from that hill. That was the thud," says Thad. "We were in luck that we did not get hit!" says Cath. "Let's go on the sixth path back to camp," says Thad. Thad and Cath jog back to camp. At camp they grab a wet cloth to wash off. "That was a fun jog," said Thad.
